proposals.description: MCP intent classification incorrectly classifies 'report' intent
proposals.rationale: This suggests a critical flaw in the intent classification system that could lead to incorrect routing or processing of user requests
proposals.proposed_action: Investigate the intent classification logic in the MCP component and fix the classification rule for 'report' intent

proposals.description: MCP intent classification shows inconsistent classification results for same intent
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent intent classification can cause unpredictable behavior in the system and affect user experience
proposals.proposed_action: Analyze the intent classification algorithm and ensure consistent results for identical or similar inputs

proposals.description: Extract completeness issue with fact extraction from user input
proposals.rationale: Incomplete fact extraction can lead to missing critical information processing and reduced system accuracy
proposals.proposed_action: Review the fact extraction logic and ensure all relevant information is captured from user inputs

proposals.description: MCP entity correctness validation fails for specific files
proposals.rationale: Entity correctness issues can lead to data integrity problems and incorrect processing of entities
proposals.proposed_action: Examine the entity validation logic in 'de_mod_pipeline.py' and fix validation rules for entity correctness

proposals.description: Extract coverage issue with short user turns
proposals.rationale: Poor coverage for short turns indicates potential gaps in the extraction system that could miss important user inputs
proposals.proposed_action: Analyze the extraction logic for short turns and improve coverage to capture all relevant information

proposals.description: MCP tags show inconsistent tag assignment
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent tagging can make system behavior unpredictable and harder to maintain
proposals.proposed_action: Review the tag assignment logic and ensure consistent tagging across similar interactions

proposals.description: Operational metrics (timing, tokens) are not recorded in review_facts
proposals.rationale: Missing timing and token usage data prevents performance monitoring and optimization of the extraction pipeline
proposals.proposed_action: Modify extract_pipeline.py to capture and store timing and token usage metrics in review_facts during the review_facts processing step

proposals.description: Activity log body lacks faithfulness scores, retry history, and unfaithful fact lists
proposals.rationale: Incomplete activity log data makes debugging and monitoring of extraction failures impossible
proposals.proposed_action: Update activity_log.body construction in extract_pipeline.py to include faithfulness scores, retry counts, and lists of unfaithful facts

proposals.description: review_facts.verdict remains 'pending' and is never updated in downstream pipeline
proposals.rationale: This prevents proper state tracking and downstream processing of extraction results
proposals.proposed_action: Implement UPDATE logic in downstream pipeline components to properly update review_facts.verdict from 'pending' to appropriate status

proposals.description: LLM client does not extract token usage and timing from API responses
proposals.rationale: Missing token usage data prevents cost tracking and performance analysis of LLM calls
proposals.proposed_action: Modify lib/llm_client.py to parse and extract token usage and timing information from /v1/completions API responses

proposals.description: enqueue_review() 함수将 queue_status 始终设置为 'reviewed'，绕过 P-R-J 流程
proposals.rationale: 这会导致所有审查都跳过必要的处理步骤，使系统无法正确跟踪审查状态和流程
proposals.proposed_action: 修改 queue_writer.py 中的 enqueue_review() 函数，根据实际审查状态动态设置 queue_status，而不是始终设置为 'reviewed'

proposals.description: fact_index 不一致，导致 mcp_meta 为 extract_model='Qwen30B' 的记录被单独存储
proposals.rationale: 这种不一致性可能导致数据不一致和查询错误，影响系统整体数据完整性
proposals.proposed_action: 检查 extract_pipeline.py 中的 _insert_fact() 函数，确保 fact_index 生成逻辑一致，避免为不同模型创建重复或不一致的记录

proposals.description: MCP 实体文件路径验证未使用绝对路径转换，存在路径遍历风险
proposals.rationale: 直接使用 os.path.join() 可能导致路径遍历攻击，允许访问系统中不受限制的文件
proposals.proposed_action: 在 extract_pipeline.py 的路径处理逻辑中，使用 os.path.abspath() 确保路径解析为绝对路径后再进行操作

proposals.description: 27B verify 模型未收集 timing/token 信息，影响性能监控和分析
proposals.rationale: 缺少关键的性能指标会阻碍对模型性能的监控和优化，影响系统整体效率
proposals.proposed_action: 修改 review_consumer.py 中的 call_verify_model() 函数，添加对 timing 和 token 使用情况的收集和记录

proposals.description: 代码中存在硬编码的模型名称 'Qwen30B'，不利于维护和扩展
proposals.rationale: 硬编码值会增加维护成本，当需要更改模型名称时需要修改多处代码
proposals.proposed_action: 将 'Qwen30B' 等硬编码值提取到配置文件或常量中，便于统一管理和修改

proposals.description: 缺少对 queue_status 变量的输入验证和边界检查
proposals.rationale: 缺乏输入验证可能导致系统处理异常状态或无效数据，影响系统稳定性
proposals.proposed_action: 在 queue_writer.py 中添加对 queue_status 参数的验证逻辑，确保其值在预定义范围内

proposals.description: Hardcoded API keys in configuration file
proposals.rationale: Exposing API keys in source code creates severe security vulnerabilities allowing unauthorized access to production systems
proposals.proposed_action: Move API keys to environment variables or secure configuration management system

proposals.description: Unvalidated user input in authentication flow
proposals.rationale: Missing input validation creates injection vulnerabilities that could allow malicious users to bypass authentication
proposals.proposed_action: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization for all authentication parameters

proposals.description: Inefficient database query with N+1 problem
proposals.rationale: Multiple database queries executed in a loop cause significant performance degradation under load
proposals.proposed_action: Use eager loading or batch queries to reduce database round trips

proposals.description: Missing CSRF protection in form submissions
proposals.rationale: Lack of CSRF tokens makes application vulnerable to cross-site request forgery attacks
proposals.proposed_action: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing form submissions

proposals.description: Duplicated error handling logic across multiple controllers
proposals.rationale: Code duplication increases maintenance burden and creates inconsistency in error responses
proposals.proposed_action: Extract common error handling into reusable middleware or service layer

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions in JavaScript files
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent naming makes code harder to read and maintain across development team
proposals.proposed_action: Enforce consistent naming conventions using ESLint or similar tooling

proposals.description: SQL injection vulnerability in user input handling
proposals.rationale: Direct concatenation of user input into SQL queries allows malicious users to execute arbitrary database commands
proposals.proposed_action: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database interactions

proposals.description: Inefficient database queries with N+1 problem
proposals.rationale: Multiple database round trips for related data causes significant performance degradation under load
proposals.proposed_action: Use eager loading or batch queries to fetch related data in single database operations

proposals.description: Missing error handling in critical business logic
proposals.rationale: Uncaught exceptions in core processes can cause application crashes and data inconsistencies
proposals.proposed_action: Add comprehensive try-catch blocks and proper error logging for all critical business operations

proposals.description: Insecure password storage without hashing
proposals.rationale: Storing passwords in plain text or with weak hashing algorithms makes user accounts vulnerable to breach
proposals.proposed_action: Implement proper password hashing with salt using industry-standard algorithms like bcrypt or Argon2

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions across modules
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent naming makes code harder to read and maintain, increases cognitive load for developers
proposals.proposed_action: Establish and enforce consistent naming conventions (camelCase, snake_case, etc.) across all codebase
